label: Good-generality (the token): the real determination of favouring the better as such
definition: goodGen is one real determination of the supplied carrier D, intended as favouring the better as such: an inclination whose favouring of candidates is a function of their betterness, including candidates that are not present inputs, rather than of one fixed end content. Nothing in Lean fixes this reading; the token is an unconstrained element of D, and its content enters only through OneFavouringRealization (an admissible profile containing it is realized by a good-general favouring).
note: Stipulative analyst notion (#2145 Investigation 4), attribution deferred. Compare the classical contrast between an appetite determined to one end and an appetite for the good as such (ST I q.19 a.4, navigation only). Whether it is a pure perfection is the separate open premise GoodGeneralityIsPure; whether it is cognitive is the separate open criterion GoodGeneralFavouringIsApprehension.
